== Description ==

Two signed copies of ''Chewbacca'' collected as tournament swag at the [[2025 World Championship]] and shared afterwards by [[Karl Koenig]] (KrazyKarl) on 7 October 2025, one inscribed "2025 WORLDS" and signed by [[Bill Kafer]] ("TACOBILL").

== Source and credit ==

* '''Source:''' Star Wars CCG Slack, #2025-world-championship-seattle, Karl Koenig (KrazyKarl), 7 October 2025 (16:06 EDT): "I have some great Swag from worlds". Original file name: IMG_2180.jpg (3024×4032, 2.7 MB); Slack file id F09K96LS9K4. Scaled here to 1927×2570 to fit the wiki's 2 MB upload limit.
* '''Shared by:''' [[Karl Koenig]] (Slack: KrazyKarl)
* '''Date:''' 7 October 2025 (Slack post date).
* '''Identification:''' No people in the photograph.
